title: Kubernetes for databases: weighing the pros and cons
by: Kate Obiidykhata, Percona, on the CNCF blog (first published on The New Stack)
summary: A short, high-level overview of why companies move databases onto Kubernetes (one platform across clouds and data centres, self-service, scaling, built-in failover) and the three ways to get there: a cloud DBaaS, a private DBaaS product, or an internal platform built from operators and monitoring. There is no technical depth or data. It is a CNCF member post by a Percona employee and ends by recommending Percona Everest, so read it as a vendor’s framing of the choice.
